description: Population projections for Australia and the states and territories is a group of 9 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the Regional Data Hub group and published by ACT Government; Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS); NSW Department of Planning and Environment. Members: Latest ACT Population Projections; Population Forecasts, WA (Western Australia Tomorrow); Population Projections, Australia; Population Projections, NSW; Population Projections, NT; Population Projections, QLD; Population Projections, SA; Population Projections, TAS; and 1 more. Example entry: Population projections for the ACT, prepared and published by the ACT Government. Data is available in a written report (PDF or DOCX) and in Excel format (XLSX) to download. Projections are calculated from 2022 to 2060. Data is available for the territory, as well as at Statistical Area Level 2 and 3 (SA2 and SA3). Projections can be broken down by age and sex. Coverage is Australia and its states and territories, 2001 to 2071; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-07-08. Files and pages listed: HTML (9 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated); other members not stated. Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
